# blinkedit-site

A mirror of https://github.com/SatyamSaxena1/SatyamSaxena1.github.io, served on the custom domain **blinkedit.me**.

The same site is also served directly at https://satyamsaxena1.github.io/ (GitHub redirects a repository's `github.io` address to its custom domain, so the two addresses need two repositories).

**Do not edit files here.** A workflow copies the source repository over every 20 minutes, and on demand from the Actions tab ("Sync site from SatyamSaxena1.github.io" -> Run workflow). Anything changed here is overwritten.
